title: 行业实训题库（制造业ERP + 电商GMV）

questions.title: 物料编码统一格式清洗
questions.question: 清洗物料编码：去除空格、-/_/.，转为大写纯字符

questions.title: 物料名称拆分：品名+规格+型号
questions.question: 从“品名(规格)#型号”中拆分三列
questions.answer_pq: Text.BeforeDelimiter([名称],"("), Text.BetweenDelimiters([名称],"(",")"), Text.AfterDelimiter([名称],"#")

questions.title: 每日GMV聚合计算
questions.question: 按日期统计GMV、订单数、支付人数
questions.answer_sql: SELECT DATE(pay_time) dt,SUM(pay_amount) gmv,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) orders FROM order_table WHERE pay_status=1 GROUP BY dt

questions.title: 月度健康度报表
questions.question: 输出：GMV、退款、毛利、净GMV
questions.answer_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time,'%Y-%m') month,SUM(pay_amount) gmv,SUM(refund_amount) refund,SUM(gross_profit) profit FROM order_table GROUP BY month
